legal.draftNotice: Draft under legal review: a lawyer has not approved this text yet and it is not final. It will be reviewed before launch.

sections.p: Rasikh is an app and website for organizing rental property. It complements the Ejar and Mullak platforms and does not replace them. This policy explains how we handle your personal data under the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law.

Account data (name, mobile number or email), the properties, leases and payments you enter, inspection and maintenance photos and files with their capture time, digital fingerprint and, when taken in the app, location, and the technical usage records we need.

Only to run your account and the services you ask for: documenting leases, payments, inspections and maintenance, reminders, buildings and ads. We do not use your data for any other purpose and we do not sell it.
We ask for your explicit consent when you create a workspace. You can withdraw it by deleting your account. The consent is needed to run the service.

The assistant runs on our servers only, on data you are allowed to see. We log metadata (request type, time, size) and do not keep the text of your question or the answer in logs. We do not train models on your data without a separate explicit consent.
Your data is kept in data centers inside the Kingdom (Dammam region). It is not moved outside except as the law allows.
You, the parties connected to the lease or property to the extent needed (owner, tenant, assigned technician), and infrastructure providers acting as processors. We do not share it for marketing.
We keep data while your account exists and as the law requires. After deletion your personal data is removed or anonymized, except what must be kept by law.

We use essential storage only: your sign-in session (Firebase Authentication) and your theme, text-size and cookie-notice preferences in your browser. We use no analytics, advertising or third-party tracking cookies. The map page shows maps through Mapbox, which may store technical data it needs to run. If you clear this storage you will need to sign in again and your preferences return to their defaults.
You may access, correct, get a copy of and ask to delete your data, and withdraw consent. Contact us at the platform address and we will answer within the legal period.
We use encryption in transit and at rest, strict per-role permissions and an audit log of sensitive actions. No system is perfectly secure, and we will report any incident as the law requires.
Questions or rights requests: privacy@rasikh.sa (a placeholder address to be confirmed before launch).

Rasikh is a tool for documenting and managing rented property. We do not conclude lease contracts, hold deposits or replace the official Ejar forms, we do not process rent payments and we offer no financing. We record what you enter and confirm.
You are responsible for the accuracy of your data and the secrecy of your sign-in. One account may hold several roles (owner, tenant, building manager, broker, vendor).

Photos and files captured in the app are stamped with time and a digital fingerprint and cannot be changed after both parties sign. This evidence is a documentation tool; decisions about it belong to the parties or the competent authorities.
The ad checker shows whether the mandatory data is complete as we understand it. It does not publish or approve an ad. The advertiser is responsible for the ad and its license.

Its outputs are machine-generated suggestions that may be wrong, and they are clearly marked. They change no record without your confirmation and are not legal opinions, official valuations or financial advice.
Do not use the platform to break the law, impersonate someone, reach data that is not yours or disrupt the service.
The service is provided as is with ordinary care and, as far as the law allows, we are not liable for indirect damages. This text is a draft awaiting legal review.
These terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the competent courts there.

sections.h: Not a substitute for the official platforms
sections.p: Rasikh complements Ejar and Mullak and does not claim official registration or representation of either. The official contract, the deposit and the official handover form stay on Ejar.
What we show is a general explanation and guidance, not a legal opinion or ruling. For legal decisions consult a licensed lawyer.

sections.h: No official valuation or financial advice
sections.p: Price indicators come from open data and are indicative, not an official valuation. We give no investment or financial advice and we do not finance or lend rent.
Help on this topic is informational, based on the announced decision as we know it, and may change. Check Ejar or a licensed professional before any decision.

Any engineering draft stays "Draft — requires review and approval by a licensed engineer" until a Saudi Council of Engineers licensed engineer approves it. We do not stamp, sign or submit permit applications on anyone's behalf.

about.title: About Rasikh
about.lead: Rasikh is a private Saudi platform that keeps everything that happens in a rented property in one record, from move-in day to move-out day, so disputes are rarer and both sides can rely on the facts.

problems.p: Move-in and move-out photos carry a capture time, a digital fingerprint and a location, and a comparison report is ready to attach in Ejar, so damage disputes are settled by evidence.
A payment ledger for every lease, with receipt uploads and reminders before each due date. We record payments; we never handle the money.
Requests with photos, a category, suggested responsibility based on Ejar guidance and a response timer. Every repair is kept in the property record.
Shared expenses with their receipts, balances every owner can see, and one vote per unit.
The broker's ad checker verifies the mandatory REGA ad data before anything is published.

who.p: From one unit to fifty: leases, payments, inspections, maintenance and reports.
Your lease, your payment schedule, your inspections and your requests in one place.
Shared expenses, balances, votes and contractor quotes.
Leads, viewings, a tamper-proof activity log and the ad checker.
Only the requests assigned to you, with status updates and a repair record.

principles.p: The official contract, deposit holding and handover form live in Ejar, and associations are registered in Mullak. Rasikh adds the day-to-day documentation.

principles.h: Your data stays in the Kingdom
principles.p: Data is stored in the Dammam cloud region (me-central2) under the Personal Data Protection Law, and you can export or delete it at any time.
Everyone sees only what is theirs: a tenant their lease, a service provider their requests, an owner their portfolio.
Rasikh is a private platform. It does not represent any government entity and gives no legal rulings, official valuations or financing.

items.a: A platform for rental documentation and property operations: leases, payments, inspections, maintenance and buildings in one record. It complements Ejar and does not replace it.

items.q: How do I create an account?
items.a: Choose “Start free”, sign up with your email, then pick your role and a workspace name. Tenants do not create a workspace; they sign up with the email the owner added to the lease.
It is free to use at this stage. We will announce any paid plans clearly before they apply.

items.q: Does Rasikh replace an Ejar contract?
items.a: No. The official contract is registered in Ejar. In Rasikh you record the Ejar contract number and follow the schedule, payments and reminders.

items.q: How do I record a payment or upload a receipt?
items.a: Open the lease under “Leases”, choose the instalment, then mark it paid or upload the receipt. Tenants can upload their receipt for the owner to see.

items.q: Does Rasikh collect rent or offer financing?
items.a: No. Rasikh only records payments. It never handles money and offers no financing or instalment plans.

items.q: What is the Riyadh rent freeze?
items.a: No annual increase on Riyadh leases for five years from 25 September 2025, and Rasikh reminds you of the renewal notice 60 days before expiry. This is indicative; check the competent authority for details.

items.q: How do I document the unit at move-in?
items.a: Start a move-in inspection under “Inspections” and photograph each room. Each photo is saved with its capture time, its SHA-256 fingerprint and, if you allow it, the location.
The owner's and tenant's signatures lock the inspection so its photos can no longer change, which makes it reliable evidence at move-out.

items.q: How do I use the comparison report in Ejar?
items.a: After the move-out inspection Rasikh produces a move-in vs move-out comparison that you download and attach in Ejar.
Rasikh suggests responsibility based on Ejar guidance: consumables fall on the tenant, basic and structural items on the owner. The suggestion is indicative and the parties decide.

items.q: How does a request reach a service provider?
items.a: The owner assigns the request to a provider. If their email is added, the provider sees it in their own account and updates it until the repair is done.

items.q: Does Rasikh register an owners association?
items.a: No. Official registration is in Mullak. Rasikh helps with day-to-day running: expenses with receipts, balances and votes.
Each unit has one vote, and every owner sees the same result live.

items.q: What does the ad checker check?
items.a: It verifies the mandatory data of a property ad, such as the FAL licence number and the ad number, and shows what is missing before you publish.

items.q: Can the activity log be edited?
items.a: No. The broker activity log is append-only with a server timestamp, so it stays a reliable reference.

items.q: How do I export or delete my data?
items.a: In the workspace, open “My account & data” and choose export or delete. This is your right under the Personal Data Protection Law.
In the Dammam cloud region (me-central2), inside the Kingdom.

items.q: What are the AI assistant's limits?
items.a: It answers property tasks inside Rasikh only. It gives no legal ruling, official valuation or financial advice, and it changes no record without your confirmation.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.lead: We want everyone to use Rasikh with ease, including people with disabilities and older users.

sections.p: Rasikh is designed to meet WCAG 2.2 level AA and the Digital Government Authority's Platforms Code for layout, type, contrast and mobile use.

An Arabic-first right-to-left interface, full keyboard navigation with a visible focus indicator, a skip link, Arabic screen-reader labels, colour contrast of at least 4.5:1, respect for reduced motion, and text-size and contrast tools in every page footer.
The 3D map and the portfolio model each have an equivalent text list with the same information, and the map falls back to a flat schematic without WebGL.
Some PDF files uploaded by users may not be screen-reader ready, and we are improving image descriptions in inspection reports.
If any page is hard to use, write to us from “Contact us” and choose “Accessibility barrier”. We will work on it.
